problem.h2: Why so many people get ripped off on their work
problem.p1: A tradesperson who disappears after the deposit. A quote that doubles with no clear explanation. Botched work that has to be redone. Deadlines missed with no recourse.
problem.p2: But not every setback is a scam. An honest tradesperson can uncover a real problem mid-project. A client can poorly describe their need at the start. And sometimes, it's simply one of life's accidents, physical or financial, that complicates everything.
problem.p3: The problem isn't that these situations exist. The problem is that today, there's no mechanism that truly protects the individual when things go wrong.
problem.p4: That's exactly why Artisan Compétent exists: anticipate risks, track every step, keep the money in escrow until everything is settled.
problem.strong: We know how things go wrong. And we put in place what's needed to prevent it.

howItWorks.h2: 3 steps for work with no nasty surprises
howItWorks.step1Body: Fill in the form in 2 minutes: type of work, service area, estimated budget. The more precise you are, the better the responses from tradespeople.
howItWorks.step2Body1: Every tradesperson on the platform is verified: valid business registration, mandatory insurance and up-to-date certifications, real customer reviews.
howItWorks.step2Body2: Tradespeople reply to you via the platform's internal chat and give you a first price range. To pin down the need and the final price, the tradesperson has to visit you. Your phone number and address are never shared with anyone until you choose to have the tradesperson over.
howItWorks.step3Title: Release the payment at the end
howItWorks.step3Body: As soon as the quote is accepted, your payment is placed in escrow. The tradesperson is only paid once you've validated the end of the project. Not satisfied? The funds stay held while the situation is resolved.

escrow.h2: Fund escrow: your guarantee against nasty surprises
escrow.p1: On other platforms, you pay the tradesperson directly before even knowing whether the work will be done well. At Artisan Compétent, it doesn't work like that.
escrow.p2: When you accept a quote, your payment is placed in an escrow account managed by a certified payment provider (Stripe). The money is held: the tradesperson has no access to it until you've validated the end of the project.
escrow.concretely1: You accept the quote and make the payment via the platform. The funds are immediately placed in escrow.
escrow.concretely2: The tradesperson carries out the work while you track progress in two ways: on your digital dashboard (photos, messages, proof, stage reports) and directly on site in person. At any time you can contradict information added by the tradesperson and take your own photos of whatever seems important to you so it is archived on the shared dashboard. Everything is tracked. Nothing can be deleted.
escrow.concretely3: Once the project is finished, you sign a completion report. The funds are released and paid to the tradesperson. If a problem arises, the funds stay held and the platform analyses the situation based on the records in the digital tracking.
escrow.strong: You only release the payment once the job is done.
escrow.klarna: And if needed, payment in 3 instalments is available via Klarna.

rule48.intro1: Your work is finished. The tradesperson asks you to sign the project completion report. And here, a simple rule protects you: you have up to 48 hours to validate it.
rule48.intro2: This 48h period applies to all projects, not just emergencies. During these 48h, the funds stay held in escrow.
rule48.actionsTitle: You notice an abuse or a defect? The right steps, in order:
rule48.action1: First talk to the tradesperson. The vast majority of situations are settled amicably. A serious tradesperson will agree to discuss the quote or come back to fix a finish. This step is essential; take the time to go through it before any other report.
rule48.action2: If the tradesperson refuses to hear your remarks, report it from your dashboard. You describe the problem (clearly excessive quote, visible defect, etc.). The funds stay held during the analysis.
rule48.action3: Amicable mediation overseen by the platform. If an abuse is confirmed after analysis, mediation is started to readjust the situation. If the tradesperson keeps refusing, the platform applies a suspension processing fee (up to €250) that is paid directly to the client from the escrowed amount. This procedure is governed by the Terms of Use and Terms of Sale.
rule48.signedTitle: And if you've already signed the report?
rule48.signedBody: Don't panic. The tradespeople on Artisan Compétent are all serious professionals and, like any good honest tradesperson, they step in to fix any defect linked to their work. And in any case, as soon as the report is signed, the legal warranties come into play, starting with the one-year defects warranty, then the two-year warranty and, depending on the type of work, the ten-year warranty.

cmodSection.h2: CMOD: a remote advisor for your work
cmodSection.p1: You're not in the trade and you're afraid of getting ripped off? CMOD is the option to call on a construction professional who advises you remotely, by video call, about your project.
cmodSection.p2: In case of doubt or dispute with your tradesperson, the CMOD report strengthens your case with an independent technical opinion. It's not a legal guarantee, it's a concrete lever to make your point.
cmodSection.changeBody: Without a full oversight mechanism, it's estimated that more than one project in two ends up botched, delayed or not finished as planned. At Artisan Compétent, the overwhelming majority of projects tracked on the platform are completed properly, and that rate rises further when the client activates CMOD support from the start of the project.
cmodSection.cond1: Quotes between €2,000 and €5,000: a free 20-minute call.
cmodSection.cond3: Full project support: paid plans available, pricing on request.

emergency.p2: And even in an emergency, fund escrow applies. You only release the payment once the job is done. And the 48h rule to react in case of abuse is even more valuable at night, when inflated quotes are most common.
emergency.trade2: Emergency heating engineer (boiler breakdown, no heating)

q1.question: What is fund escrow?
q1.answer: Fund escrow is a mechanism where your money is placed in a held account (managed by Stripe) as soon as you accept a quote. The tradesperson only receives payment once you've validated the end of the project. It's the best protection against scams on building work.

q2.question: How does Artisan Compétent verify tradespeople?
q2.answer: Every tradesperson is checked before joining the platform: business registration check, verification of mandatory insurance (professional liability, ten-year warranty, and any insurance specific to their activity), verification of up-to-date certifications (RGE, Qualibat, etc. depending on the services offered), and monitoring of real customer reviews. A tradesperson who doesn't follow the rules is removed from the platform.

q3.question: How much does it cost for an individual?
q3.answer: Matchmaking is free. You only pay the amount of the accepted quote, via escrow. Artisan Compétent earns its income through a commission paid by the tradesperson, taken only from the labour portion. Never from materials. This commission is independent of the quote presented to you.

q4.question: What is the CMOD?
q4.answer: The CMOD is a Digital Client Project Advisor. A construction professional who supports you remotely by video call to check that your work is progressing correctly. For quotes between €2,000 and €5,000, a 20-minute call is free. Above €5,000, it's 45 minutes. Full project support is available as a paid option, pricing on request.

q5.question: Can I pay in several instalments?
q5.answer: Yes. Payment in 3 instalments is available via Klarna directly on the platform.

q6.question: Does Artisan Compétent operate everywhere in France?
q6.answer: The platform is in a gradual rollout phase. Artisan Compétent already covers the main French cities and expands month after month, with the long-term goal of covering mainland France and the overseas territories down to the smallest villages. If your town isn't covered yet, you can encourage your local tradespeople to join the platform: the more there are, the faster your area will be available. A serious tradesperson has no reason to refuse an overseen system like ours.

q7.question: What should I do if I disagree with the quote or the work delivered?
q7.answer1: The first thing to do is talk to the tradesperson. The vast majority of situations are settled amicably: a serious tradesperson will agree to revisit the quote or come back to fix a finish. Take the time for that discussion before any other report.
q7.answer2: If the tradesperson refuses to listen to your remarks, you can then report it from your dashboard, within 48h after the end of the work. During this window, the funds stay held in escrow and the platform analyses the situation. If an abuse is confirmed, amicable mediation is started, and if the tradesperson keeps refusing, a processing fee (up to €250) is charged to them for the client's benefit.

q8.question: What happens if I don't validate the completion report within 48h?
q8.answer: As long as you haven't validated the report, the funds stay held in escrow. That's the window to report any problem (after talking to the tradesperson, see the previous question). Once the report is signed, the funds are released to the tradesperson and only the legal warranties remain available (defects warranty, two-year and ten-year warranties depending on the work).

q9.question: What happens if the work is done badly?
q9.answer1: First step: discuss it with the tradesperson. Many defects are fixed as soon as they're raised. If the tradesperson refuses to step in, don't sign the report within the 48h and report the situation from your dashboard. The funds stay held and the platform analyses the situation based on the digital tracking (photos, messages, CMOD reports if activated).
q9.answer2: If the report is already signed, the serious tradespeople on the platform step in spontaneously to fix a defect. And in any case, the legal warranties take over (defects, two-year and ten-year warranties).

q10.question: How can I avoid scams when looking for a tradesperson?
q10.answer: The best way to avoid scams is to never pay a tradesperson directly before the work is finished. On Artisan Compétent, your money is overseen by fund escrow: the tradesperson is only paid when you validate the project. It's the best protection against excessive quotes, botched work and tradespeople who disappear.

meta.title: Artisan Compétent Partner Program | 20% Commission
meta.description: Recommend Artisan Compétent to your audience and earn 20% commission the first year. Free signup, no commitment, no upfront cost.

hero.subtitle: Recommend the platform that puts an end to construction scams. Earn 1 year of commission on every new client: 20% the first 6 months, 10% the next 6. No long-term contract, no commitment, no upfront cost.

howItWorks.title: Three steps, that's it.
howItWorks.step1Body: Free signup, no minimum audience required. You receive a unique affiliate link and a short code, both tied to your partner account. That's how your referrals are tracked.
howItWorks.step2Title: Talk about Artisan Compétent to your audience.
howItWorks.step2Body: To your family, your followers, your clients, your network. Video, post, story, word of mouth — your call. The only rule: at least one piece of content per week, so we know you're active (and so your audience keeps you in mind).
howItWorks.step3Body: When the person you referred takes action and the work is completed (handover certificate signed), your commission is validated. Quarterly bank transfer and PDF receipt available in your partner dashboard. And every month, you receive an email report with the number of referrals signed up thanks to you and the status of each.

commissions.title: It's simple. Really.
commissions.summaryClient: You refer a client: 20% the first 6 months, 10% the next 6.
commissions.summaryArtisan: You refer a professional: 5% for 6 months.
commissions.summaryBoth: You do both: you stack, up to 25%.
commissions.detailsTitle: The details if you need them
commissions.detailClient: Individual client: 20% commission on Artisan Compétent's margin during the first 6 months after the client's signup, 10% during the next 6 months. After 12 months, the commission ends.
commissions.detailArtisan: Referred professional: 5% on the margin generated by jobs signed through this professional, for 6 months after their signup on the platform.
commissions.detailCumul: Stacking: if you bring in both a client and a professional, you earn on both. The same person can therefore earn up to 25% on a single job (20% on the client side + 5% on the professional side).
commissions.condition1: Attribution cookie valid for 15 days after the first click on your link. It renews with every new click from a visitor via your link. So in practice, as long as you publish regularly, the cookie stays active.
commissions.condition2: On top of the cookie, your referral is tied to your partner account at signup. You earn commissions for the 12 months following their signup (6 months for any referred professional).
commissions.condition3: You must publish at least one piece of content per week to stay active. After 7 days without publication, you receive a warning. After 14 days, your link is deactivated. All referrals already tied to your account keep generating commissions normally.
commissions.condition4: Commissions only apply to Artisan Compétent's margin. Never on materials, never on the labor billed by the professional.
commissions.condition5: Quarterly bank transfer, starting from the handover certificate signed by the client. No payment on signed quote alone, because a quote can still be cancelled mid-job.

whyRecommend.title: You're not selling a product. You're selling protection. And you're building your brand.
whyRecommend.intro: Recommending Artisan Compétent isn't pushing yet another offer. It's telling your audience: here's how to put an end to inflated quotes, vanishing professionals, and botched jobs that you have to pay for anyway. Whether for a major renovation project or an emergency intervention of one or two days, the platform covers the full range.
whyRecommend.arg1: Escrow protection: the client's money is only released to the professional after the work is validated. That speaks to everyone.
whyRecommend.arg2: Professionals are verified (business registration, public liability insurance, ten-year warranty). No shady profiles.
whyRecommend.arg3: The CMOD service is an option to better oversee the job. For quotes between €2,000 and €5,000, a first 20-minute call is free. For quotes above €5,000, it's a 45-minute call.
whyRecommend.arg4: Signup is free for both clients and professionals. No barrier to entry.
whyRecommend.arg5: Klarna's split payment is available up to €1,500 on quotes, for both major projects and emergency interventions. Subject to the professional accepting to cover the fees (4.9% of the total quote).
whyRecommend.outro: If your audience includes homeowners, renters who want to renovate, condo owners, or simply people who are afraid of getting ripped off on a job, you have a natural audience for Artisan Compétent.

brandFomo.title: An opportunity not to miss.
brandFomo.body1: Recommending Artisan Compétent positions you as a trusted creator. Other brands see this as a signal of reliability, which can open up new partnership opportunities.
brandFomo.body2: And let's be lucid: you don't own your audience. The people who follow you also follow other creators. If you don't recommend Artisan Compétent today, someone else will tomorrow. And they'll be the ones earning the commission.
brandFomo.analogyTitle: An analogy to see the stakes
brandFomo.analogy: Imagine you own a 100,000 m² plot of land. Your neighbors each have 100 m² adjacent to yours. An oil company comes to you: there's oil under your land, we'll extract it and pay you a percentage. You refuse because you want more. The company simply goes to your neighbors, installs its rigs, and extracts the same oil. You missed the opportunity. Your audience works exactly the same way.

expectations.title: No magic, no promises. Just consistency.
expectations.exp1: At least one publication per week mentioning Artisan Compétent: video, post, story, podcast, or article.
expectations.exp2: One proof to add each week in your partner dashboard (direct link to your publication). Takes 30 seconds: copy the link to your post, paste it in the dedicated field, done.
expectations.exp3: Respect for the legal framework: no lying about what the platform is, no overselling what it does. Transparency is our hallmark, and we expect the same from our partners.
expectations.exp4: Normal use of your link: no spam, no purchase of unqualified traffic, no cookie fraud. Any manipulation triggers immediate suspension without notice.
expectations.note: We don't ask for minimum numbers, no KPI to hit. The only rule is consistency. If you publish every week, you stay in the program, whether you make 2 signups or 200.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need a large audience to join the program?
faq.a1: No. The program is open to everyone, no minimum threshold. A friend who tells 5 people about Artisan Compétent can generate a commission. We prefer 100 active and consistent partners over 10 large passive audiences.
faq.q2: When do I get my commission?
faq.a2: When the job is finished. Concretely: your referral signs their quote, the work is done, they sign the handover certificate, and that's when your commission is validated. Payment is quarterly by bank transfer.
faq.q3: Why not when the quote is signed?
faq.a3: Because a quote can still be cancelled mid-job (issue, accident, disagreement), in which case the client is refunded via escrow. On a signed handover certificate, it's clean: the work is done, the money is released, your commission is due.
faq.q4: What happens if I stop publishing?
faq.a4: Don't worry. If more than 7 days go by without proof of content, you receive a warning. After 14 days, your affiliate link is deactivated. All referrals already tied to your account keep generating commissions normally. You can reactivate your link at any time by resuming activity.
faq.q5: What if the person I referred takes time to take action?
faq.a5: You have 15 days after the first click for the conversion to be attributed to your link via the cookie. This duration is intentionally short to encourage you to publish regularly. The cookie renews with every new click from a visitor via your link. Good news: your referral is also tied to your partner account at signup, so we can keep paying you for the 12 months following (6 months for any referred professional).
faq.q6: Can I combine this program with other affiliations?
faq.a6: Yes, no problem. The only case where we cut the link is if you simultaneously recommend a direct competitor of Artisan Compétent (another platform with escrow).
faq.q7: Can I refer my own clients or friends?
faq.a7: Yes, as long as the person you refer actually uses the platform for a real job. Referring close contacts without a real project is considered cookie fraud and triggers suspension.
faq.a8: You enter your IBAN in your partner dashboard. Payment is automatic by bank transfer every quarter. A PDF receipt is generated and downloadable from your dashboard.
faq.q9: What do I have to declare for taxes?
faq.a9: Commissions are income to be declared. Depending on your status, the tax regime differs. Artisan Compétent provides an annual summary of amounts paid. We recommend consulting a tax advisor if you exceed €2,000 in commissions per year.

ctaFinal.title: Ready to join the program?

legal.title: Legal notice and program conditions
legal.item1: The partner program is open to adult individuals and to legal entities established in France or the European Union.
